description: This file declares standard string and memory manipulation functions commonly used in C programming, in addition to a cache flush function. It appears to be part of the Linux kernel or a low-level hardware interface, given the SPDX license identifier and the inclusion of generic utility functions.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies the string pointed to by src, including the terminating null byte, to the buffer pointed to by dest.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to n bytes from src to dest.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates the string pointed to by src to the end of the string pointed to by dest.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of character c in string s.

methods.name: strrchr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the last occurrence of character c in string s.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares the first n bytes of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of the string s.

methods.name: strnlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of string s, but at most count.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills the first n bytes of the memory area pointed to by s with the constant byte c.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies n bytes from src to dest, handling overlapping memory areas.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies n bytes from src to dest.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Scans the first n bytes of s for the character c.

methods.name: memcmp
methods.description: Compares the first n bytes of s1 and s2.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes the cache for a given memory region, likely for hardware synchronization.
